command:
set -euo pipefail
kubectl -n kcm-system wait backup/post-upgrade-qa-restore --for=jsonpath='{.status.phase}'=Completed --timeout=20s
kubectl create namespace qa-backup-restore
cat <<'EOF' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: velero.io/v1
kind: Restore
metadata:
  name: qa-configmap-restore
  namespace: kcm-system
spec:
  backupName: post-upgrade-qa-restore
  includedNamespaces: [kcm-system]
  namespaceMapping:
    kcm-system: qa-backup-restore
  includedResources: [configmaps]
  includeClusterResources: false
  labelSelector:
    matchLabels:
      qa-restore-probe: "true"
EOF
stdout:
backup.velero.io/post-upgrade-qa-restore condition met
namespace/qa-backup-restore created
restore.velero.io/qa-configmap-restore created
